title: Replace deprecated Authlib JOSE imports
description: Migrate backend JOSE key-set import and JWT decoding to joserfc to remove AuthlibDeprecationWarning while preserving OIDC validation behavior.
acceptance_criteria: backend no longer imports authlib.jose; OIDC JWT/JWKS behavior remains intact; related tests pass.
close_reason: Migrated JWKS and ID-token validation to joserfc, declared the direct dependency, and verified OIDC claims with five focused tests plus the full backend suite.

title: Align Playwright CI with current frontend
description: Replace the retired Flask-backed root browser test configuration with the existing React/Vite frontend Playwright suite, and update CI dependencies so npm run test:ci starts the actual frontend.
acceptance_criteria: npm run test:ci launches the current frontend and passes its Playwright suite; GitHub Actions installs its dependencies; workflow YAML validates.
close_reason: Root test:ci now delegates to the current frontend Playwright suite; GitHub Actions invokes it with the frontend dependencies installed. Updated the localStorage test helper so all 45 Playwright tests pass.

title: Pin Playwright CI runners to supported Ubuntu
description: Playwright browser dependency installation fails on ubuntu-latest resolving to Ubuntu 26.04 with the repository's Playwright 1.58.2. Pin browser-test jobs to Ubuntu 24.04 so install-with-deps uses a supported OS.
acceptance_criteria: Playwright CI jobs run on Ubuntu 24.04; workflow YAML validates.
close_reason: Pinned both Playwright CI jobs to Ubuntu 24.04, avoiding Playwright 1.58.2's unsupported Ubuntu 26.04 dependency-install path.

title: Add existing test suites to CI pipeline
description: Wire backend pytest and root/frontend Playwright suites into GitHub Actions, and make image builds depend on passing tests.
acceptance_criteria: Backend pytest and frontend/root Playwright suites run in CI; Docker builds only run after tests pass; workflow remains valid.
close_reason: Added pull-request and build-gated CI jobs for backend pytest, frontend unit/lint/build, backend Playwright, and frontend Playwright; fixed Playwright test discovery.

title: Batch RF-DETR tracking and measure pipeline utilization
description: Increase person tracking throughput by batching RF-DETR over buffered scene frames, overlap bounded scene decoding with inference, retain ordered ByteTrack updates, and report pipeline queue/timing signals to determine whether GPU inference is starved.
acceptance_criteria: RF-DETR processes bounded frame batches through its supported list API; ByteTrack receives results in original per-scene order; configurable worker and batch limits remain memory-bounded; progress exposes decoded/batched/queued frame counts and stage timings; docs explain CPU/GPU limits and what utilization metrics represent.
close_reason: Implemented batched RF-DETR scene tracking with bounded decode queues and progress telemetry; backend suite passes.

title: Cache face samples during tracking
description: Avoid reopening and decoding the source video during identity analysis by persisting selected aligned face samples from the tracking pass.
acceptance_criteria: Tracking persists a bounded set of quality-diverse aligned face candidates per track; identity analysis selects up to five final references from those candidates without reopening the video; track merges/splits retain correct candidate ownership; temporary sample files follow existing cleanup behavior.

title: Invalidate reference embeddings after face review
description: Face review changes can exclude observations or split tracks, so cached per-track embedding references must be deleted alongside persons and attributes. This was fixed in stage_state.save_faces and covered by the existing face review invalidation path.
close_reason: Removed stale reference vectors when face-review changes invalidate identity assignments.

title: Validate CUDA 13.2 on cluster GPUs
description: Run a GPU smoke test of the PyTorch 2.13 CUDA 13.2 backend image on cluster nodes currently labeled with NVIDIA driver 580.126.20. Confirm CUDA minor-version compatibility in practice and coordinate a driver upgrade to branch R595 if required before production rollout.
notes: Implemented AD_PERSON_DEVICE=cuda for Kubernetes so RF-DETR uses CUDA or fails loudly; corrected Docker --gpus all run example. Code tests and Kustomize render pass. Still requires smoke testing on cluster after deployment to confirm host driver/device exposure.

title: Update PyTorch CUDA base image
description: Identify a current, available CUDA-enabled pytorch/pytorch image tag and update the backend Docker base image and its tightly coupled dependency versions if necessary, preserving compatibility and validating the relevant build configuration.
close_reason: Updated the backend image and CUDA wheel index to PyTorch 2.13/CUDA 13.2, removed the unused TorchAudio dependency from VAD, regenerated the lockfile, passed 13 targeted tests, and built and smoke-tested the image. Cluster GPU runtime validation is tracked separately.

title: Fix unavailable Torch dependency pin
description: Replace the unavailable torch==2.13.0 requirement in pyproject.toml with an available version compatible with the project's torchvision constraint, so uv can resolve dependencies.
close_reason: Updated the unavailable Torch pin and verified uv dependency resolution with a dry run.

title: Add Hugging Face model hub credentials
description: Encrypt the supplied Hugging Face access token as namespace-scoped SealedSecrets and configure backend model-hub interactions to consume it, without storing plaintext in the repository.
close_reason: Added and validated namespace-scoped Hugging Face SealedSecrets and backend HF_TOKEN wiring.

title: Improve person management UI
description: Build a person management dialog with representative image selection, similarity-aware ordering, person details, representation image changes, merging, and post-merge join suggestions.

title: Add cancellation for person-analysis stages
description: Let users see person-stage phase progress and cancel tracking, identity, or attribute work. Cancellation must stop queued tasks, cooperatively stop running work at safe checkpoints, report a cancelled state, and leave the last published artifacts unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: The person-stage UI shows the active step and progress and offers a cancel action; cancellation stops queued work and active tasks at safe checkpoints, cleans staging data, preserves prior published artifacts, and reports cancellation distinctly from failure.
close_reason: Implemented person-stage cancellation and progress controls for tracking, identities/face embeddings, and attributes; publication boundaries are protected.

title: Implement bounded worker pools for person workflows
description: Implement the staged design in docs/person-workflow-worker-pool-plan.md: bounded scheduling, scene-parallel tracking, parallel identity preparation with deterministic global clustering, and structured progress reporting. Resolve model concurrency and rollout gates before raising inference concurrency. This issue tracks implementation work after the plan is reviewed.
acceptance_criteria: Person workflow subtasks run under bounded configurable worker limits; outputs and review/revision guarantees remain deterministic; progress survives refresh/reconnect and reports task counts; representative benchmarks show a repeatable speedup before concurrency above one is enabled by default.
close_reason: Implemented bounded person-stage and task pools, deterministic scene/identity aggregation, structured progress, and conservative concurrency defaults; validation passed.

title: Document a worker-pool plan for person analysis
description: Create a repository design document for bounded job/worker-pool execution across person tracking, identity embedding, clustering, and attribute extraction, including progress reporting, state safety, rollout, and validation.
acceptance_criteria: A concrete implementation plan is documented against the current backend and frontend architecture, with rollout phases and measurable acceptance criteria.
close_reason: Documented the implementation plan in docs/person-workflow-worker-pool-plan.md.

title: Add project contributors to citation metadata
description: Add the provided contributor names to CITATION.cff while preserving existing citation fields.
close_reason: Added the requested contributors to CITATION.cff.

title: Add citation metadata
description: Add a CITATION.cff file with accurate project citation metadata based on the repository.
close_reason: Added CITATION.cff with project citation metadata.
